_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-74 base rate on ±2pt 12h moves makes HOLD the only statistically defensible call—no breaker (fed_liquidity, VIX, or DXY reversal) has fired to justify a directional claim, and the coil of trapped positioning needs a catalyst to resolve either way.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial agreement—both place the market in Anxiety with a HOLD lean, but the analyst is more cautious (0.55 confidence, divergence-heavy) while the narrative writer is more optimistic (0.72 confidence, momentum-forward framing).
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity rises above 20 AND btc_momentum_30d sustains above 60 AND funding stays below 65 — controlled re-risking that lifts the coil toward Hope (Disbelief rung, score 55-62)
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 80 AND dxy_weakness reverses below 60 AND exchange_netflow spikes above 70 — macro shock forcing panic de-risk, dropping the score toward Complacency (47-54) or Panic (24-31)
